- Gmsh 4.15.2 is copyright Christophe Geuzaine and Jean-François Remacle and distributed under GPL-2.0-or-later with an exception. See [license](Gmsh-LICENSE.txt) and [credits](Gmsh-CREDITS.txt). The matching upstream Gmsh source archive is attached to the [FlowForm release](https://github.com/teho00/flowform-releases/releases/tag/v0.1.1).
- Open CASCADE Technology 7.9.3 is copyright OPEN CASCADE SAS and the other copyright holders named in its source. It is distributed under [LGPL-2.1](OCCT-LGPL-2.1.txt) with the [Open CASCADE exception](OCCT-exception.txt). [Source](https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT/tree/V7_9_3).
- CadQuery OCP 7.9.3.0 provides Python bindings. Its own configuration and generated bindings are distributed under [Apache-2.0](OCP-Apache-2.0.txt), subject to the separate terms on OCCT-derived material. [Source](https://github.com/CadQuery/OCP/releases/tag/7.9.3.0) and [packaging source](https://github.com/CadQuery/ocp-build-system).
- The Python runtime includes its license in `runtime/LICENSE.txt`. Python dependencies retain license files and metadata under `runtime/Lib/site-packages`.
- The WebView2 bootstrapper is provided by Microsoft. OpenFOAM and the optional NVIDIA acceleration dependencies are obtained separately using their respective distribution channels.
